title: Two New Species of the Genus Philanthaxia Deyrolle, 1864 from Hainan Province, China (Coleptera, Buprestidae, Thomassetiini)
content: In this paper, we describe two new species of Philanthaxia Deyrolle, 1864, from Hainan, China: P. longicorna Ni & Song, sp. n. and P. lui Ni & Song, sp. n. The characters of the new species are described with illustrations, and comparisons are made with the most similar species.
